system.description:
Starting at 6th level, the range at which you are able to cast your bard spells through your imaginary friend increases to 60 feet.

Additionally, you learn the spell @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.eceeym81z9dq6r58]{Major Image}. It counts as a bard spell for you, and does not count against the number of spells you know.

When you summon your imaginary friend while the effects of major image are active, your imaginary friend may appear in the area of effect instead of a square adjacent to you. Your imaginary friend blends into the illusion and cannot be detected at a glance. If you attempt to cast a bard spell with a range of touch through your imaginary friend, the target has disadvantage on its saving throw. If a creature succeeds on their check to see through the illusion, they immediately detect your imaginary friend.
